_why.TRAIL_SHOULDER_W: 8 px shoulders thin the lines and leave dark ground between the inner corridors; strobe 0.0117 to 0.0118, noise
_why.TRAIL_ALPHA: 0.44 lets the tram red and bus blue read as thin lines and cuts strobe 0.0118 to 0.0114; no added white
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 2nd round: 1.2 px dots are the target's small sharp points and still read after VP9; strobe 0.0064 to 0.0041
_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 lingers on the busy day so peak dots jump less per frame: strobe 0.0041 to 0.0038; the night still takes 6 s
_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 3rd round: 40 min cuts strobe 0.0035 to 0.0033; lines stay thin red and blue with dark blocks between, no white
_why.TRAIL_LAYER_ALPHA: 0.8 cuts strobe 0.0114 to 0.0106 with no white; 0.95 cuts more but its brighter lines swallow the 1.2 px dots
_why.rush.FRAME_ZOOM: 2nd round: 0.81 lifts safe share 0.89 to 0.92; Donaustadt stays above y 800, clear of the button column
_why.rush.BUS_CORE_R: 2nd round: 1.2 px matches the day's small sharp dots and still reads after VP9; strobe 0.0066 to 0.0043
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 4th round: 32 min cuts close-up strobe 0.0036 to 0.0032; thin whole lines with dark blocks, as the target
